module_title: National Sports Awards - Lifetime Categories, MAKA Trophy, and Current Laureates
introduction: Tailored for UPSC, State PCS, and SSC CGL Tier-2, this advanced module breaks down the nuanced differences between the 'Dhyan Chand' named awards, explores the historic MAKA Trophy given to institutions, and highlights the highly-tested recent awardees of the 2024-2025 cycle.

core_concepts.title: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna vs. Dhyan Chand Award
core_concepts.description: A critical distinction! The 'Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna' is the highest honor for CURRENT peak performance (₹25 lakh). The 'Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement' (instituted in 2002) is a separate award given to veterans for their contribution to sports during their active career and post-retirement (₹10 lakh).

core_concepts.title: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy
core_concepts.description: Instituted in 1956-57, it is India's oldest National Sports Award. It is NOT given to an individual athlete, but to the 'Overall top-performing University' in inter-university tournaments. The winning university receives a rolling trophy and ₹15 lakh.

core_concepts.title: Recent Khel Ratna Winners (2024 Awards)
core_concepts.description: In the 2024 cycle (presented in Jan 2025), four elite athletes won the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna: D Gukesh (Chess), Harmanpreet Singh (Hockey), Praveen Kumar (Para-Athletics), and Manu Bhaker (Shooting).

core_concepts.title: Two Categories of Dronacharya
core_concepts.description: The Dronacharya Award is split into two classes: 1. 'Regular Category' (for producing recent outstanding results, ₹10 lakh). 2. 'Lifetime Category' (for outstanding coaching contributions over 20+ years, ₹15 lakh).

important_entities.name: Chandigarh University
important_entities.significance: Emerged as the overall winning university for the prestigious Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy in the 2024 cycle.

important_entities.name: Swapnil Kusale & Sarabjot Singh
important_entities.significance: Alongside Khel Ratna winner Manu Bhaker, these Olympic medal-winning shooters were honored with the Arjuna Award in the 2024 cycle.

important_entities.name: Pankaj Advani
important_entities.significance: The only Indian athlete to win the Khel Ratna (2005) for his absolute dominance in two distinct, yet related sports: Billiards and Snooker.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners will set a trap by asking: 'Which award is given for lifetime achievement in sports?' Do NOT select 'Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna'. You must explicitly select 'Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement'. Do not mix the two.

Students often assume the Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy goes to an individual politician or a cricket team. Remember, India's first Education Minister's namesake trophy strictly goes to a 'University'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: The Education Minister awards the University
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad was India's first Education Minister, making it logical that his namesake (MAKA) trophy is awarded to an educational institution (University).

exam_strategy_tips: For Tier-2 exams, you must memorize the discipline of recent Khel Ratna winners. Knowing the names is insufficient. E.g., You must know D Gukesh is mapped to Chess, and Praveen Kumar to Para-Athletics.
